<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/alarm-rules"}

Query the alarm rule list with pagination (template rules are excluded).
Optionally filter by case-insensitive substring match on `ruleName`.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
